statement_map.email_excerpt: Leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.
Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it.
A test form filled in from your other email address then delivered the email, and you confirmed it is working correctly now.
Emails can sometimes go to spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea.
You can do this in the email domain part of the settings.
Verify your sender domain in the email domain part of the settings (you said you would do this the morning after our call).
